fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that a series of small debits adding up to Rs. 50,000 appeared in the statement of the complainant without any authorisation. The matter was brought to Karur East PS on 2025-08-02, while the incident was placed on 2025-08-01 around 13:05 hrs. The online submission was made by Anand Chandran (9000000060). A person named Nithin Murugan, associated with the number 9000000374, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The account reference SYN-ACC-100047 linked to the complainant was mentioned in relation to the transactions. Items referenced in the complaint: social media screenshots.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Multiple small transfers reportedly made in quick succession.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, screenshot, suspect, afternoon, shopping complex, mobile number, bank account
